name: agentlytics-mcp
description: Self-hosted, cookieless website analytics with an MCP server your AI agent can read. Runs on Cloudflare Workers and D1.

SITE_DOMAIN.description: Your website's domain without https:// or www, e.g. example.com. Only visits from this domain are recorded.

HASH_SECRET.description: Any long random string (e.g. from `openssl rand -hex 32`). Used to make the daily visitor id; never share it.

MCP_READ_KEY.description: Another long random string. Your AI agent sends it as the Bearer token to read your analytics; keep it private.
